verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Agentic Accounts and an Agentic Wallet that let an AI agent hold USDC and spend it on x402 services, and buyers can pay from a CDP wallet. That covers the core of an agent-held spending wallet. Nothing in the pack documents how the user funds the wallet, what owner controls or limits apply (only batch-settlement escrow limits and refunds are described), or any balance visibility, and the Advanced Trade option is still 'coming soon'. Missing for 10: documented user funding flow, owner controls and spending limits on the agent wallet, balance visibility, independent hands-on corroboration.
